tldr: Mercury through the 4th house brings focus to home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body: Mercury transiting the 4th house activates home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. For a few weeks, thought, conversation, planning, and messages move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a thinking transit: it favors planning, conversations, edits, decisions, and information-gathering around the house topic.
business: Mercury supports home base and inner stability: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Overthinking, mixed messages, or retreating into old patterns.
advice: Name the details in the 4th house deliberately. Work with home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
